title: Affineness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of schemes over $S_0$, where $S_0$, $X_0$, $Y_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the base change of $f_0$ to $S_i$ ($X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, $Y_i=Y_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) and $f:X\to Y$ its base change to $S$. If $f$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], then $f_i$ is affine for some $i\ge0$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01ZN).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), in Situation Tag 081D (situation-descent-property, line 1739); its proof (lines 1757-1770): a finite affine open covering $Y_0=\bigcup_jV_{j,0}$, $U_{j,i}=f_i^{-1}(V_{j,i})$, $U_j=\lim_iU_{j,i}$ (Lemma Tag 01YX), Lemma Tag 01Z6 (lemma-limit-affine, line 680) and Morphisms, Lemma Tag 01S8 (lemma-characterize-affine)

proof.text: *Step 1 (the base changes and their projections).* Write $f_{ii'}:S_i\to S_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) for the transition morphisms, $f_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$, and $p_i:S\to S_i$ for the projections of the limit. Let $T$ be $S_i$ for some $i\ge0$, with $c_T=f_{i0}:T\to S_0$, or $S$, with $c_T=p_0$. Put $X_T=X_0\times_{S_0}T$, $Y_T=Y_0\times_{S_0}T$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and $f_T=f_0\times\mathrm{id}_T:X_T\to Y_T$, so $f_{S_i}=f_i$ and $f_S=f$; for $T=S_0$ the first projections $X_0\times_{S_0}S_0\to X_0$, $Y_0\times_{S_0}S_0\to Y_0$ are isomorphisms (base change along the identity) under which $f_{S_0}=f_0$, and we identify along them. (a) $c_T$ is affine: $f_{i0}$ is a transition morphism (affine by hypothesis; $f_{00}=\mathrm{id}$ is affine, the preimage of an affine open being itself [pqf-def-affine-morphism]) and $p_0$ is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. The first projection $\mathrm{pr}_1:Y_T\to Y_0$ is the base change of $c_T$ along the structure morphism $h:Y_0\to S_0$ (by the symmetry of the fibre product), hence affine by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](1); likewise $\mathrm{pr}_1:X_T\to X_0$ is affine. (b) Apply [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting] to the diagram with left column $X_T\xrightarrow{f_T}Y_T\xrightarrow{\mathrm{pr}_2}T$, right column $X_0\xrightarrow{f_0}Y_0\xrightarrow{h}S_0$ and horizontal maps the first projections and $c_T$: it commutes ($\mathrm{pr}_1f_T=f_0\mathrm{pr}_1$ by definition of $f_0\times\mathrm{id}_T$, $h\,\mathrm{pr}_1=c_T\mathrm{pr}_2$), the lower square is cartesian by definition of $Y_T$, and the outer rectangle is cartesian by definition of $X_T$ (the structure morphism of $X_0$ is $hf_0$, and $\mathrm{pr}_2f_T=\mathrm{pr}_2$); so the upper square is cartesian: $f_T$ is the base change of $f_0$ along $\mathrm{pr}_1:Y_T\to Y_0$. (c) Since $X_0$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $Y_0$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $f_0$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1), and so is its base change $f_T$ by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), proof (lines 1757-1770): the notation $f_i$, $f$ of Situation Tag 081D (line 1739); the base changes are written out here

proof.text: *Step 2 (a finite affine covering and the pieces $V_{j,T}$, $U_{j,T}$).* $Y_0$ is a scheme, hence covered by affine opens [def-pc-scheme], and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], so $Y_0=\bigcup_{j=1}^mV_{j,0}$ for finitely many affine opens $V_{j,0}$ ($m=0$ if $Y_0=\emptyset$). Put $U_{j,0}=f_0^{-1}(V_{j,0})\subseteq X_0$ and, for $T$ as in step 1, $V_{j,T}=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(V_{j,0})\subseteq Y_T$ and $U_{j,T}=f_T^{-1}(V_{j,T})\subseteq X_T$; write $V_{j,i},U_{j,i}$ for $T=S_i$ and $V_j,U_j$ for $T=S$ (for $T=S_0$ this agrees with $V_{j,0},U_{j,0}$ under the identification of step 1). (a) The $V_{j,T}$ ($j=1,\dots,m$) cover $Y_T$, being the preimages of a covering. (b) Each $V_{j,T}$ is an affine open of $Y_T$: it is the preimage of the affine open $V_{j,0}$ under the affine morphism $\mathrm{pr}_1:Y_T\to Y_0$ (step 1(a), [pqf-def-affine-morphism]). (c) Since $\mathrm{pr}_1\circ f_T=f_0\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$ (step 1(b)), $U_{j,T}=f_T^{-1}\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(V_{j,0})=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}f_0^{-1}(V_{j,0})=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(U_{j,0})$, the preimage of $U_{j,0}$ under $\mathrm{pr}_1:X_T\to X_0$. (d) $U_{j,T}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated: by [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product] the restriction $f_T|:U_{j,T}\to V_{j,T}$ is the base change of $f_T$ along the inclusion $V_{j,T}\hookrightarrow Y_T$, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated by step 1(c) and [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3); as $V_{j,T}$ is affine, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine] gives that $U_{j,T}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), proof (lines 1757-1770): 'Let $Y_0=\bigcup_{j=1,\ldots,m}V_{j,0}$ be a finite affine open covering. Set $U_{j,0}=f_0^{-1}(V_{j,0})$ ... $U_j=f^{-1}(V_j)$'; the quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of the $U_{j,i}$, which Lemma 01Z6 (Situation 086P) requires, is supplied here

proof.text: *Step 3 ($U_j$ is affine).* Take $T=S$ in step 2: $V_j$ is an affine open of $Y$ (step 2(b)) and $f$ is affine by hypothesis, so $U_j=f^{-1}(V_j)$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. (The source says 'since $U_j$ is affine by assumption'; $V_j$ is affine because the projection $p_0:S\to S_0$ is affine, step 1(a).)

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), proof (lines 1757-1770): 'Since $U_j$ is affine by assumption'

proof.text: *Step 4 ($U_j=\varprojlim_{i\ge0}U_{j,i}$, with affine transition morphisms).* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit] with the $S_0$-scheme $X_0$ in place of $T$: the schemes $X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$ ($i\ge0$) with $t_{ii'}=\mathrm{id}_{X_0}\times f_{ii'}:X_i\to X_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'\ge0$) form an inverse system over the directed set $I_{\ge0}$ with affine transition morphisms, and $X=X_0\times_{S_0}S$ with the morphisms $q_i=\mathrm{id}_{X_0}\times p_i:X\to X_i$ is its limit in the category of schemes. Under the identification $X_0\times_{S_0}S_0=X_0$ of step 1, $t_{i0}$ and $q_0$ are the first projections $\mathrm{pr}_1:X_i\to X_0$, $\mathrm{pr}_1:X\to X_0$. Now apply [lem-weil-pbc-limit-cone-affine-projections-opens](2) to this inverse system over $I_{\ge0}$, the index $0$ (the least element of $I_{\ge0}$) and the open $U_{j,0}\subseteq X_0$: the opens $t_{i0}^{-1}(U_{j,0})\subseteq X_i$ ($i\ge0$), with the restricted transition morphisms, form an inverse system over $I_{\ge0}$ with affine transition morphisms, and $q_0^{-1}(U_{j,0})\subseteq X$, with the restricted projections, is its limit in the category of schemes. By step 2(c), $t_{i0}^{-1}(U_{j,0})=U_{j,i}$ and $q_0^{-1}(U_{j,0})=U_j$. So $U_j=\varprojlim_{i\ge0}U_{j,i}$ with affine transition morphisms $U_{j,i}\to U_{j,i'}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), proof (lines 1757-1770): 'Then $U_j=\lim_{i\ge0}U_{j,i}$ (see Lemma \ref{lemma-directed-inverse-system-has-limit})', i.e. Lemma Tag 01YX(2), applied to the system $X_i$ whose limit is $X$ by Lemma Tag 01YZ (lemma-scheme-over-limit, line 114)

proof.text: *Step 5 (each $U_{j,i}$ is affine for $i$ large).* Fix $j$. The inverse system $(U_{j,i})_{i\ge0}$ over the directed set $I_{\ge0}$ consists of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes (step 2(d)), has affine transition morphisms and limit $U_j$ (step 4), and $U_j$ is affine (step 3). By [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-stage] (with $I_{\ge0}$ in place of $I$) there is $i_j\ge0$ such that $U_{j,i}$ is affine for every $i\ge i_j$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), proof (lines 1757-1770): 'we see that each $U_{j,i}$ is affine for $i$ large enough, see Lemma \ref{lemma-limit-affine}' (Lemma Tag 01Z6, line 680)

proof.text: *Step 6 (a common index; $f_i$ is affine).* Since $I$ is directed and there are finitely many $j$, there is $i\in I$ with $i\ge0$ and $i\ge i_j$ for $j=1,\dots,m$ (induction on $m$; $i=0$ if $m=0$). Take $T=S_i$ in step 2: the $V_{j,i}$ ($j=1,\dots,m$) are affine opens covering $Y_i$ (step 2(a),(b)), and $f_i^{-1}(V_{j,i})=U_{j,i}$ is affine for every $j$ (step 5, as $i\ge i_j$). Hence $f_i$ is affine by [pqf-lem-affine-local-target] (the implication from the existence of an affine open covering of the target with affine preimages; Morphisms, Lemma Tag 01S8, (2)$\Rightarrow$(1)).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1750), proof (lines 1757-1770): 'As there are finitely many $j$ we can pick an $i$ which works for all $j$. Thus $f_i$ is affine for $i$ large enough, see Morphisms, Lemma \ref{morphisms-lemma-characterize-affine}' (literature/stacks-project/morphisms.tex, Lemma Tag 01S8, line 1736)

split_report.summary: Statement checked against Limits 01ZN in Situation 081D (limits.tex lines 1739-1770) and kept; stmt_deps kept. Proof written in six steps following the Stacks proof: (1) the base changes $X_T,Y_T,f_T$ for $T=S_i$ or $S$, $\mathrm{pr}_1:Y_T\to Y_0$ affine, $f_T$ the base change of $f_0$ over $Y_0$ (pasting) and quasi-compact and quasi-separated; (2) the finite affine covering $V_{j,0}$ of $Y_0$, the pieces $V_{j,T}$ (affine, covering) and $U_{j,T}=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(U_{j,0})$, quasi-compact and quasi-separated (needed for Lemma 01Z6, which the source does not check); (3) $U_j$ affine ($V_j$ is affine because $p_0$ is affine, which the source leaves implicit); (4) $U_j=\lim U_{j,i}$ with affine transition maps, from Limits 01YZ (the $X_i$ have limit $X$) and 01YX(2) (preimages of an open), which the source cites as 01YX alone; (5) Limits 01Z6 for each $j$; (6) common index by directedness and Morphisms 01S8. No new node: every step uses existing nodes. All tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags (01ZN, 081D, 01YX, 01YZ, 01Z6, 086P, 01S8). Off-route use: pqf-lem-affine-local-target (Morphisms 01S8, unit sk-prop-nagata-sketch-zmt, unsplit) is a generic tool lemma used as a black box, for the lead to record in tool_uses or to make a Mathlib leaf (HasAffineProperty @IsAffineHom, Morphisms/Affine.lean:146, with HasAffineProperty.iff_of_openCover, Morphisms/Basic.lean:571).
